shortDescription: Manages configuration of an OSPF VPN instance on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: bandwidth
options.description: Specifies the reference bandwidth used to assign ospf cost. Valid values are an integer, in Mbps, 1 - 2147483648, the default value is 100.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies the description information of ospf process.

options.name: lsaaholdinterval
options.description: Specifies the hold interval of arrive LSA when use the intelligent timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 0 to 10000, the default value is 500.

options.name: lsaainterval
options.description: Specifies the interval of arrive LSA when use the general timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 0 to 10000.

options.name: lsaalflag
options.description: Specifies the mode of timer to calculate interval of arrive LSA. If set the parameter but not specifies value, the default will be used. If true use general timer. If false use intelligent timer.

options.name: lsaamaxinterval
options.description: Specifies the max interval of arrive LSA when use the intelligent timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 0 to 10000, the default value is 1000.

options.name: lsaastartinterval
options.description: Specifies the start interval of arrive LSA when use the intelligent timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 0 to 10000, the default value is 500.

options.name: lsaoholdinterval
options.description: Specifies the hold interval of originate LSA . Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 0 to 5000, the default value is 1000.

options.name: lsaointerval
options.description: Specifies the interval of originate LSA . Valid value is an integer, in second, from 0 to 10, the default value is 5.

options.name: lsaointervalflag
options.description: Specifies whether cancel the interval of LSA originate or not. If set the parameter but noe specifies value, the default will be used. true:cancel the interval of LSA originate, the interval is 0. false:do not cancel the interval of LSA originate.

options.name: lsaomaxinterval
options.description: Specifies the max interval of originate LSA . Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 1 to 10000, the default value is 5000.

options.name: lsaostartinterval
options.description: Specifies the start interval of originate LSA . Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 0 to 1000, the default value is 500.

options.name: ospf
options.description: The ID of the ospf process. Valid values are an integer, 1 - 4294967295, the default value is 1.

options.name: route_id
options.description: Specifies the ospf private route id,. Valid values are a string, formatted as an IP address (i.e. "10.1.1.1") the length is 0 - 20.

options.name: spfholdinterval
options.description: Specifies the hold interval to calculate SPF when use intelligent timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 1 to 5000, the default value is 200.

options.name: spfinterval
options.description: Specifies the interval to calculate SPF when use second level  timer. Valid value is an integer, in second, from 1 to 10.

options.name: spfintervalmi
options.description: Specifies the interval to calculate SPF when use millisecond level  timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 1 to 10000.

options.name: spfintervaltype
options.description: Specifies the mode of timer which used to calculate SPF. If set the parameter but noe specifies value, the default will be used. If is intelligent-timer, then use intelligent timer. If is timer, then use second level timer. If is millisecond, then use millisecond level timer.

options.name: spfmaxinterval
options.description: Specifies the max interval to calculate SPF when use intelligent timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 1 to 20000, the default value is 5000.

options.name: spfstartinterval
options.description: Specifies the start interval to calculate SPF when use intelligent timer. Valid value is an integer, in millisecond, from 1 to 1000, the default value is 50.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: vrf
options.description: Specifies the vpn instance which use ospf,length is 1 - 31. Valid values are a string.
